scope: Campaign integration, ownership, transactional admission, native build/source binding, checkpoint/replay, modes/defaults and plotting. No new physical or lifetime proof reviewed.

checks.prior_and_ownership: Compressed uses fixed public mean/root and identity prior precision once. Full history replaces, never multiplies, the same-prefix native distribution; native bridge enforces committed counters.
checks.truth_separation: Estimator constructors/objectives take calibration and indexed five-column observations. Truth is confined to existing synthesis, scoring and plots; no new truth import/access in bank backend.
checks.temperature_and_support: CLI rejects nonconstant/non25C before output creation; adapter rejects non25C before native mutation. Existing physical-path and full fixed log-shape support remain; no clipping or recentering.
checks.transaction: Backup includes native context, joint QR root, legacy H/path state, three free/forced banks, original-coordinate solver start, pending rows and audit. Tested later-chunk QR rollback and native partial-window rollback.
checks.replay: Checkpoint binds source/config/center/cadence/width/map. Replay binds campaign source dependencies, build receipt, copied map, native response binaries and host runtime. Nonzero checkpoint replay is bitwise exact in targeted fixture.
checks.defaults_and_controls: Default joint-field and existing control outputs unchanged; compare-bank selects mainline field64 plus distinct_bank on identical observations.
checks.plots: Individual and summary figures, per-parameter comparison pages, unique bank color and different bank/control summary linestyles verified.
checks.source_and_build: Bank helpers built before independent workers, source/map/binary identities verified on reuse, helper sources and map archived. Signed original map is not renormalized.

tests.note: 8 campaign + 6 bank + 7 legacy field tests; before final plot-only linestyle/assertion edit.
Final reviewed plot/test bytes, after linestyle/assertion adjustment.

tests.stdin_reproducer:
import numpy as np
from experiments.distinct_bank_integration_001.test_campaign import BankCampaignTests as T
T.setUpClass()
try:
    t=T();stream,banks,_=t.restore();bank=banks['distinct_bank']
    before=bank.checkpoint_arrays();context=bytes(bank.context);counts=bank.counts()
    first=stream.index;rows,_,_=stream.read(16)
    bad=rows.copy();bad[1,0]=2.
    try:bank.advance(first,bad)
    except ValueError as exc:assert str(exc)=='C estimator status -2'
    else:raise AssertionError('native row rejection missing')
    assert bytes(bank.context)==context
    for k,v in before.items():np.testing.assert_array_equal(bank.checkpoint_arrays()[k],v)
    assert bank.counts()==counts
    bank.advance(first,rows)
    assert bank.counts()['retired_records']==first+16
finally:T.tearDownClass()
tests.result: Native row2 dt=2 caused status -2 after row1 acceptance; context/all checkpoint arrays/counters unchanged; retry accepted.

limits: Supplied N13e map remains uncertified NUM; TaylorH2 approximation and stationary25C only.
W94/35720B packed factor/936B response plus rolling carrier and Python/native workspace remain over target; no M23 claim.
Local Gaussian widths lack deterministic approximation bias allowance or validated coverage; no lifetime/aging qualification.
